text:
About 80% of the world's population lived in low and lower-middle income countries in 1997. The team note is wrong: China and India were both still below the $1230 line then, which is why they account for roughly a third of world population in that group. I haven't checked this against the World Bank's 1997–1999 figures, so treat 80% as a recollection.

CONFIDENCE: 55
